rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: high street (pilot), Amber spine, arterials - trees in wells on the shop side, palms alternating on Amber (zone 406 -> about 360); this block's trees stand on grass, a front strip along Tenth and the back yards
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The block's eighteen builder trees go (a front row on the grass along Tenth every 5-15 m, a row along the back fences with torrey pines by the clotheslines); five come back on their own spots: three of the front row about every other one, and two in the back yards with room round them.

trees.why: the front grass along Tenth, 4.7 m from the building: the street row's west tree
the same front strip 45 m on: every other tree of the old row
the front strip's east end, 27 m on, nothing round it
the back yards' open middle, 9.6 m from the walls, by the bougainvillea
the east back yard, 8.5 m from the house: the yard's tree
